abstract: Agent skill for OpenRLHF, the Ray + vLLM + DeepSpeed RLHF framework: install via the NGC container, SFT, reward model and DPO training, PPO, REINFORCE++, GRPO and RLOO on Ray, custom reward and agent functions, hybrid-engine and async placement, Slurm, LoRA merge, troubleshooting and updating. References split by install, SFT/RM/DPO, RL, rewards, scaling, troubleshooting and updating, plus a hybrid-engine template.
